cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(binary_artifact_check CXX)
set(ENGINE_NAME binary_base)
add_library(binary_base STATIC native/base.cpp)
target_compile_definitions(binary_base PUBLIC Foo=1)
if(PACKAGE_CONFIG)
    include("${PACKAGE_CONFIG}")
    add_executable(binary_consumer native/main.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(binary_consumer PRIVATE binary_plugin)
else()
    add_library(binary_math SHARED native/math.cpp)
    add_library(binary_static STATIC native/static.cpp)
    if(EXPORT_IPO)
        set_property(TARGET binary_static PROPERTY INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION TRUE)
    endif()
    add_library(binary_external STATIC native/external.cpp)
    add_library(binary_whole STATIC native/whole.cpp)
    add_library(binary_link_whole STATIC native/link-whole.cpp)
    add_library(binary_plugin STATIC native/plugin.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(binary_plugin PRIVATE binary_base binary_static binary_math binary_external.lib "$<LINK_LIBRARY:WHOLE_ARCHIVE,binary_link_whole>")
    target_link_options(binary_plugin INTERFACE "/WHOLEARCHIVE:$<TARGET_FILE:binary_whole>")
    add_dependencies(binary_plugin binary_whole binary_external)
    target_compile_definitions(binary_plugin INTERFACE CPD_PUBLIC_VALUE=7 FOO=1 "CPD_ESCAPED=\"a\\\\b\"")
    target_include_directories(binary_plugin INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/native/include/subdirectory")
    target_compile_options(binary_plugin INTERFACE /Zc:__cplusplus)
    set(CC_REGISTERED_PLUGINS binary_plugin)
    include("${BINARY_METADATA_MODULE}")
endif()
